summary: Icahn Enterprises L.P. filed an 8-K announcing a definitive Stock Purchase Agreement to sell its wholly owned subsidiary The Pep Boys-Manny, Moe & Jack Holding Corp. to Mavis Tire Supply, LLC for a base purchase price of $700 million, subject to customary adjustments. The registrant Icahn Enterprises, as seller via its subsidiary Icahn Automotive, guarantees payment/performance. No board recommendation or outside advisors named. The buyer must pay a $21M reverse termination fee in certain termination scenarios. The transaction is expected to close within months, subject to regulatory and customary closing conditions. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and potential competing bids given Icahn's activist profile.
